name: Hasegawa Kyousuke
source:
An office worker.
Star Sign: Taurus
Hobby: Driving
Likes: Wine
Dislikes: Cats, Sticky things like Natto

A guy the protagonist meets by chance during an accident while job hunting.
She meets him a few times after that.
